Taking z² coefficient and only lowering nonnegative A_i and s_j gives Φ_{n-2}/2^n -binom(n,2)≥sum(v_i/4-1)+2(n-2)sum(L_i/8-1)+4sum_{i<j}(L_i/8-1)(L_j/8-1). Nontriangles give nonnegative terms, while triangle contributes -1/4 offset by n>=3 perimeter excess >=(3sqrt3-4)/4, yielding (6sqrt3-9)/4 per triangle. Equality in total ridge bound requires no triangles and tangent squares/perimeter8 plus length-two intervals, hence precisely centered cube. In n=3 triangle×[-1,1] reaches the triangle-deficit coefficient; its vertices satisfy distance≥sqrt2. Independent product-polynomial checks m<=3, ell<=5 with triangles/squares and intervals passed; uniform theorem is by coefficientwise proof, not finite checking.
